prf_candidates.title: Forestry

candidate.rationale_en: The declared model tracks observable stand conditions and time-indexed follow-up; assess whether the System-State Tracking template genuinely fits forest stands.

prf_candidates.scope: Represent stand states, growth, disturbance, interventions and follow-up over time.
prf_candidates.critical_distinction: A modeled forest trajectory is not an observed management outcome.

prf_candidates.title: Infrastructure

candidate.rationale_en: The native model compares service capacity, failure states and dependencies; examine whether observed multi-system state matrices are actually present.

prf_candidates.scope: Map infrastructure topology, capacity, service, dependencies, failure modes and resilience.
prf_candidates.critical_distinction: Designed redundancy is not proof of current availability.

prf_candidates.title: Manufacturing

candidate.rationale_en: A material-to-process-to-quality flow is described, but a real stepwise protocol with roles, exceptions and authorization must be demonstrated before adopting this PRF.

prf_candidates.scope: Connect raw materials, processes, geometry, tolerances, manufactured parts and quality controls.
prf_candidates.critical_distinction: A procedure specification is not evidence of a conforming part.

prf_candidates.title: Paleontology

candidate.rationale_en: The fossil and lineage material may include a natural-object classification, but its primary model appears inferential rather than taxonomic.

prf_candidates.scope: Connect fossil observations to strata, age estimates, ancient organisms and reconstructed lineages.
prf_candidates.critical_distinction: A fossil observation and reconstruction of life history are different evidence levels.

prf_candidates.title: PublicHealth

candidate.rationale_en: Population metrics and intervention outcomes may allow comparisons of observable states, but this is not established from metadata alone.

prf_candidates.scope: Relate population groups, exposure, health measures, interventions, outcomes and distributions.
prf_candidates.critical_distinction: Population-level evidence does not automatically predict individual outcomes.

prf_candidates.title: Soil

candidate.rationale_en: The horizon and soil-class observations could support a source-bounded natural taxonomy, but classification criteria and primary usage must be checked.

prf_candidates.scope: Connect horizons, texture, chemistry, biology, water, fertility and contextual measurements.
prf_candidates.critical_distinction: A soil observation without depth and method is incomplete.

prf_candidates.title: Weather

candidate.rationale_en: The model explicitly distinguishes current observations from forecasts; assess whether weather station state comparisons match the profile.

prf_candidates.scope: Connect atmospheric observations, current states, analyses, forecasts, hazards and uncertainty.
prf_candidates.critical_distinction: Observed weather and forecast weather must remain distinct.
